reference.title: BEAT (Heartbeat) LED
reference.shortdesc: In normal operation, the yellow heartbeat BEAT LED blinks at 1 Hz, with a 50%/50% on/off duty cycle.

section.p:
After power is applied, during bootup, the “BEAT” LED flashes at a 1 Hz rate, at 50%/50% on/off duty cycle. The bootup process status is indicated by blink patterns as described in the table below.
Do not remove power from the controller during bootup or during other critical operations, such as firmware upgrade to the controller or any attached modules. .
If the BEAT LED stays on constantly, does not light, or blinks very fast, contact System Engineering for technical support.
